# Chip: `jl-chip`

A compact token: a filter to turn on and off, a tag to take away, or a label.

- Class `JlChip`, an atom: `import { JlChip } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/chip

Chips are small tokens: filters people turn on and off, tags they can take away, or plain labels.
A selectable chip is a toggle button (aria-pressed); pressing it fires change with its new state.

A removable chip has an × that fires dismiss: the page removes the chip, or the value it stands for. Backspace and
Delete on a focused selectable chip do the same.

## Use

```ts
import { JlChip } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlChip icon="filter" label="Open issues" selectable />
```

```html
<jl-chip icon="filter" label="Open issues" selectable></jl-chip>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The text.
- `icon` (attribute `icon`): `string`, default `''`. An icon before the label.
- `selectable` (attribute `selectable`): `boolean`, default `false`. Turns on and off when pressed, as a toggle button.
- `selected` (attribute `selected`): `boolean`, default `false`. On: drawn in the accent colour.
- `removable` (attribute `removable`): `boolean`, default `false`. Shows an × that fires dismiss.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Cannot be pressed or dismissed.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md'`, default `'md'`. 28 or 24 pixels high.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `boolean`: A selectable chip was pressed; the detail is its new state.
- `dismiss` (`onDismiss` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The × of a removable chip was pressed.

## Slots

- The default slot: Rich content after the label.

## Methods

- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the chip, or its dismiss button when it cannot be selected.
- `toggle(): void`: Turns a selectable chip on or off as a press would, and fires change.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The chip.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Filters

Press to turn a filter on and off; a selected chip without an icon shows a check.

```html
<div class="row demo-filters">
  <jl-chip label="All" selectable selected></jl-chip>
  <jl-chip label="Open" selectable></jl-chip>
  <jl-chip label="In review" selectable></jl-chip>
  <jl-chip label="Merged" icon="check" selectable></jl-chip>
  <jl-chip label="Archived" selectable disabled></jl-chip>
</div>
<p class="muted demo-filter-state">Showing: All</p>
```

```js
const chips = [...root.querySelectorAll('.demo-filters jl-chip')];
const state = root.querySelector('.demo-filter-state');
for (const chip of chips) {
  chip.events.register('change', () => {
    const on = chips.filter((each) => each.selected.get()).map((each) => each.label.get());
    state.textContent = `Showing: ${on.join(', ') || 'nothing'}`;
  });
}
```

### Removable tags

The × fires dismiss; here the page takes the chip away.

```html
<div class="row demo-tags">
  <jl-chip label="design" removable></jl-chip>
  <jl-chip label="accessibility" removable></jl-chip>
  <jl-chip label="web components" icon="puzzle" removable></jl-chip>
  <jl-chip label="locked" icon="lock"></jl-chip>
</div>
```

```js
for (const chip of root.querySelectorAll('.demo-tags jl-chip[removable]')) {
  chip.events.register('dismiss', () => chip.remove());
}
```

### Sizes

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-chip size="sm" label="Small" selectable selected></jl-chip>
  <jl-chip size="sm" label="Small tag" removable></jl-chip>
  <jl-chip label="Medium" selectable selected></jl-chip>
  <jl-chip label="Medium tag" removable></jl-chip>
</div>
```
